entries.scope: Non-Windows Tauri GTK dependency branch retained in Cargo.lock
entries.release_impact: Not linked into the Windows x86_64 release target
entries.review_basis: GitHub Dependabot alert #1 remains open; the Windows x86_64 dependency tree still has no glib edge, so this is a non-Windows GTK branch risk and not part of the shipped target.
entries.required_follow_up: Re-evaluate when Tauri or its runtime dependency graph changes; upgrade through a separately validated compatibility PR.
